name: slicc-bios
description: Slim loader that boots SLICC into OPFS and serves the UI from there

scripts.test:unit: mcr --name slicc-bios-unit --reports lcovonly,console-details --outputDir coverage/unit --all src --filter '{"**/src/**/*.js":true,"**":false}' node --test 'test/unit/**/*.test.mjs'
scripts.coverage:staged: npm run --silent test:unit && uvx diff-cover@10.6.0 coverage/unit/lcov.info --compare-branch HEAD --ignore-unstaged --fail-under 100
scripts.lint: biome check . && npm run lint:comments && npm run lint:no-unit-tests
scripts.lint:comments: d=node_modules/.cache/no-comment-9cc7617; [ -f $d/check.mjs ] || { mkdir -p $d && for f in lib comments marker check; do curl -fsSL -o $d/$f.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc/9cc7617c94c24b84c4d6fd8edf92441378257d07/packages/dev-tools/no-comment/$f.mjs || exit 1; done; } && node $d/check.mjs --force
